# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest tagged release.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 0.2.x | Yes |
| Earlier | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use GitHub's private
security-advisory reporting for this repository. Include reproduction steps and the
affected version, but never attach real sensitive documents, `.env` files, prompts,
model responses, databases, credentials, or private-review reports.

Maintainers will acknowledge a report as availability permits, investigate it
privately, and coordinate disclosure after a fix is available. This project is
maintained without a guaranteed response-time SLA.

For the product threat model and non-guarantees, read the repository
[security model](../SECURITY.md).
